releaseNotes: Choosing repairs is clearer: the checkbox now works separately from the row highlight, checked actions carry their own tint, and Apply Selected shows the exact count of chosen actions.
New Select Safe and Clear Selection controls make multi-action review quick and predictable.
Selected rows use a high-contrast warm highlight so every label stays readable.
Closing Workbook Audit now returns cleanly to Excel without minimizing it or changing the Excel window state.

Manual-review findings provide guided choices instead of dead ends: expert users can explicitly convert identifier-like text with a clear warning, open Excel's own Edit Links dialog for external sources, and choose which duplicate row to keep.
An empty cell inside a calculating sequence is now reported as a restorable missing formula with a preview.
